cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(DorisAvroCpp LANGUAGES CXX)

# Keep Avro's optional FetchContent fallback and host-package discovery out of the build.
unset(DORIS_AVRO_INCLUDE_DIR CACHE)
find_path(DORIS_AVRO_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES fmt/format.h
          PATHS "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/include" NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CACHE REQUIRED)
foreach(codec z snappy zstd)
    unset(DORIS_AVRO_${codec}_LIBRARY CACHE)
    find_library(DORIS_AVRO_${codec}_LIBRARY NAMES ${codec}
                 PATHS "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib" "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib64"
                 NO_DEFAULT_PATH NO_CACHE REQUIRED)
endforeach()
file(GLOB AVRO_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS impl/*.cc impl/parsing/*.cc impl/json/*.cc)
list(FILTER AVRO_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/avrogencpp\\.cc$")
add_library(avrocpp_s STATIC ${AVRO_SOURCES})
target_compile_features(avrocpp_s PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_compile_definitions(avrocpp_s PRIVATE
    AVRO_SOURCE FMT_HEADER_ONLY SNAPPY_CODEC_AVAILABLE ZSTD_CODEC_AVAILABLE)
target_include_directories(avrocpp_s PRIVATE include/avro "${DORIS_AVRO_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    "${DORIS_AVRO_INCLUDE_DIR}/zstd")
target_link_libraries(avrocpp_s PRIVATE ${DORIS_AVRO_z_LIBRARY}
    ${DORIS_AVRO_snappy_LIBRARY} ${DORIS_AVRO_zstd_LIBRARY})
set_target_properties(avrocpp_s PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
install(TARGETS avrocpp_s ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY include/avro DESTINATION include FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.hh")
